Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking our onboarding request. Attached are our completed W-8BEN-E (signed) and a bank letter confirming our US bank account for wire payments. We are a Cayman Islands holding entity with a US-reported EIN under our US subsidiary — that EIN appears on the bank letter. The W-8BEN-E references our foreign entity EIN in section 10, however you may see a mismatch in the IRS name/EIN when you crosscheck with the procurement portal.

If possible, we need the PO released on a provisional basis while compliance completes the crosswalk — VelaHealth is targeting an April 15 start for professional services. Let me know what other evidence you need; I can escalate to our accounting team.

Subject: Re: W-8BEN-E + bank letter attached (VelaHealth)

Hi Arjun —

Thanks for sending these over and for the context. Quick summary of what I see and what we need to clear the PO:

1) The W-8BEN-E lists VelaHealth Holdings Ltd (Cayman) and a foreign tax identifier — good.
2) The bank letter shows your US banking relationship and references the EIN for VelaHealth USA Inc (a US subsidiary). Our procurement system (and our tax team) requires a direct match between the tax identifier on the onboarding profile used for invoicing and the tax id on the W-8/W-9 evidence.
3) If you will invoice Redwood (US) directly from the US subsidiary (VelaHealth USA Inc) we will need either a completed W-9 for the US entity or a clear delegation/contractual relationship showing payments routed through that subsidiary.

Can you confirm: will invoices come from VelaHealth Holdings (Cayman) or from the US subsidiary? If the US subsidiary will be the invoicing party, please provide a W-9 for that entity or a signed notice from your accounting team confirming invoicing flow. If the Cayman entity will invoice, we need a short legal declaration explaining why the EIN/Name are different plus a copy of the foreign entity’s equivalent government registration.

Copying Laura from Procurement so she can advise on provisional PO options while we resolve the tax evidence.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding — Redwood Procurement
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0124

- EIN_Screenshot_irs_2027-03.png (screenshot from IRS EIN verification for VelaHealth USA Inc)
- Intercompany_Invoicing_Delegation.pdf (internal declaration) [sent in follow-up email]

Hi team — looping procurement.

Ben — vendor claims: contracting entity is Cayman Holdings, invoices issued by US subsidiary (VelaHealth USA Inc). They just sent an IRS EIN screenshot and will follow with W-9 + intercompany declaration. Request: can we issue a provisional PO with a caveat ("payment contingent on receipt and verification of W-9/EIN for invoicing entity") so project scheduling can begin? Their target start is April 15.

Notes for your intake: the W-8 is present (for Cayman), bank letter confirms US account. This is a cross-jurisdiction invoicing flow — we commonly accept provisional POs where finance holds final approval and payments are blocked until tax docs are fully verified.

Please advise SLA for verification and any additional docs you want recorded in PROC ticket PROC-4452.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: W-8BEN-E + bank letter attached (VelaHealth)

Hi all — thanks for the clear notes. Plan below: 

1) Procurement can issue a provisional PO (PO-2027-8341) with an explicit payment-contingent hold. That lets Redwood scheduling and ops treat the engagement as approved for planning; procurement will not authorize invoice payment until finance confirms W-9 + EIN match.

2) Required items to remove hold and convert to a standard PO:
   - Signed W-9 for VelaHealth USA Inc (PDF, notarization not required for US entity)
   - Intercompany invoicing delegation (signed by authorized signatory)
   - IRS EIN verification screenshot or IRS letter (we've accepted screenshots in recent cases)

3) Please upload documents to the PROC ticket (link below) and confirm via reply. Once finance confirms the EIN/w9 match we will change PO-2027-8341 to "Active" and remove the hold. Expected turnaround: finance verification 1–2 business days after receiving complete docs.

4) Action owner: Meera (VelaHealth) to upload docs; Olga/Laura to confirm upload and routing.

Proc ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4452
PO (provisional): PO-2027-8341 — "payment contingent on tax evidence"

Ben Carter
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
Attachment stubs referenced: "W-9_VelaHealth_USA_signed.pdf" (expected)

Looking forward to getting this started — April 15 is still our target for kickoff.
